questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 8 advise concerning the king's command?
options: Speak against it boldly before the royal court
Leave his presence the moment you disagree with him
Resist it whenever it conflicts with your own wishes
Keep it, because of your oath before God
questions.answer: Keep it, because of your oath before God

questions.question: What does the Preacher conclude that no man has power over?
options: The wind, to restrain it, or the day of his death
The rising and the setting of the sun each day
The rivers that run endlessly down into the sea
The times and seasons that are appointed under heaven
questions.answer: The wind, to restrain it, or the day of his death

questions.question: Ecclesiastes 8 says it will be well with those who fear God, who fear before him.
No man has power to retain the spirit, or power over the day of _____.
It will be well with those who fear God, who are reverent in His _____.
